edges: Lucius asks Samuel Dockwrath to leave Orley Farm.
Samuel Dockwrath investigates Lady Mason for forgery.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mr. Furnival and his wife are reconciled.
Joseph Mason left his estate to his family, but a codicil left Orley Farm to his second wife and infant son.
Sir Peregrine falls in love with Lady Mason and is briefly engaged to her.
Sophia has a brief engagement to Lucius Mason.
Joseph Mason the younger is persuaded by Samuel Dockwrath to have Lady Mason prosecuted for forgery.
Mr. Furnival befriends Lady Mason, arousing the jealousy of his wife.
Sophia has a brief relationship with Augustus Stavely.
Joseph Mason left his estate to his family, but a codicil left Orley Farm to his second wife and infant son.
Sophia is portrayed as an intelligent woman who writes comically skilful letters.
